description: This repository contains three Python simulation scripts for the discovery and registration of optical network units in IEEE 802.3av access networks. The README distinguishes clustered, randomly spaced and equidistant unit layouts, gives package installation and run commands, and shows figures from repeated trials. Users vary the number of new units and a maximum waiting time; outputs are registration-efficiency surfaces for each layout. The topology is an abstract passive optical network, not a named operator deployment. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that the scripts model a narrow registration procedure and published example plots do not establish performance in a full telecom network with equipment faults or competing traffic. The model can examine how access-network provisioning delays affect service restoration or capacity planning. Its three layouts permit controlled comparison of spatial assumptions. No script or simulation output was downloaded or executed. The related platform-ns-3 catalogue record is a general communications simulator; this repository instead provides specialised optical-unit registration scripts.
inputs: Number and layout of optical network units; maximum waiting time
name: IEEE 802.3av ONU registration simulations
